title: EXISTENTIAL WITNESS -> UNIVERSAL COVERAGE BRIDGE
purpose: Formalize the transition from proving or verifying one existential witness for a particular input to establishing universal coverage over an entire bounded input domain, while preventing local witness success from being misread as a global theorem.

source_case.origin: A discussion of the internet Rule 34 meme used as a deliberately informal toy model for the quantifier transition.
source_case.local_question: For a particular object x, does there exist some witness y satisfying a verifier relation V(x,y)?
source_case.global_question: For every admissible object x in a declared domain, does there exist some witness y satisfying V(x,y)?
source_case.generalization: The mechanism is domain-independent and applies to proof search, testing, coverage claims, constructive existence claims, successor grammars, search spaces, and other JANUS verification pipelines.
source_case.epistemic_note: The source metaphor motivates the quantifier structure only; it is not itself treated as a formal complexity-theory problem until a finite encoding, input parameterization, witness bound, and verifier are explicitly declared.

formal_objects.z: instance parameter defining the bounded problem family or environment under test
formal_objects.D_z: declared admissible domain of x values for instance z
formal_objects.x: one candidate input, object, state, case, or challenge from D_z
formal_objects.y: candidate existential witness associated with x
formal_objects.V: falsifiable verifier returning ACCEPT or REJECT for (z,x,y)
formal_objects.coverage_property: FOR ALL x in D_z, EXISTS y: V(z,x,y)=ACCEPT

local_existential_layer.interpretation: A single x is locally discharged when at least one bounded witness y is accepted by the verifier.
local_existential_layer.certificate: The accepted witness y plus enough provenance to replay V(z,x,y).
local_existential_layer.complexity_shape: When V is polynomial-time and the witness is polynomially bounded, LOCAL has the standard NP witness-verification shape.
local_existential_layer.non_claim: NP-shaped verification does not imply that finding y is polynomial-time, nor does it imply P=NP.

universal_coverage_layer.formula: COVER(z) := FOR ALL x in D_z, EXISTS y, |y|<=p(|z|+|x|) : V(z,x,y)=1
universal_coverage_layer.interpretation: Coverage is a quantified statement over every admissible x, not a collection of anecdotes, samples, or successful representatives.
universal_coverage_layer.decision_form: z in L iff FOR ALL polynomially bounded x EXISTS polynomially bounded y such that R(z,x,y)=1, for polynomial-time decidable R.
universal_coverage_layer.complexity_shape: Under the standard finite polynomially bounded encoding above, this forall-exists decision form is characteristic of the second universal level of the polynomial hierarchy, Pi_2^P. This is a structural classification of the formalized decision language, not a claim that every informal forall-exists sentence is Pi_2^P-complete.
universal_coverage_layer.completeness_firewall: Membership-shaped quantifier structure != hardness or completeness proof. Pi_2^P-completeness requires a separate reduction argument.

transition_operator.name: EXISTENTIAL_WITNESS_TO_UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE
transition_operator.expanded_form: LOCAL_WITNESS_VERIFICATION -> DOMAIN_DECLARATION -> UNIVERSAL_CHALLENGE_ENUMERATION_OR_PROOF -> PER-CHALLENGE_EXISTENTIAL_DISCHARGE -> COVERAGE_AUDIT -> UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE_OR_OPEN
transition_operator.quantifier_lift: EXISTS y V(z,x,y)  ==>  FOR ALL x in D_z EXISTS y V(z,x,y)
transition_operator.critical_rule: The arrow denotes a new proof obligation, not logical implication. Local existence must never be promoted to universal coverage without discharging the outer universal quantifier.
required_inputs: polynomial or otherwise declared bound on x when complexity classification is claimed
coverage strategy capable of addressing every admissible x or proving a stronger invariant that entails all x

coverage_strategies.finite_polynomial_domain: If |D_z| is polynomially bounded, explicit enumeration plus one verified witness per x can itself be a polynomial-size coverage certificate.
coverage_strategies.large_or_exponential_domain: If D_z is exponentially large, storing one witness per x is generally not a polynomial-size certificate; use a stronger symbolic invariant, constructive witness function, induction, reduction, grammar theorem, or another proof mechanism.
coverage_strategies.constructive_uniform_resolver: A function F(z,x)=y with a proof that V(z,x,F(z,x))=1 for every x in D_z is stronger than isolated witness storage and directly targets universal constructive coverage.
coverage_strategies.counterexample_search: One x for which no admissible y exists falsifies universal coverage, but inability to find such x under bounded search does not prove coverage.
coverage_strategies.sampling: Random, adversarial, or representative sampling can increase confidence and discover counterexamples but cannot by itself discharge an unrestricted universal quantifier.

janus_gate.forbidden_promotion: LOCAL_WITNESS_FOUND -> UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE_VERIFIED without a coverage proof
janus_gate.resource_transition: Coverage procedure exhausts declared resources without theorem or counterexample -> UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT

proof_obligations.requirement: Specify exactly which x values are quantified over and why no admissible cases are silently excluded.
For each discharged x, witness y must be replayably accepted by V.
V must be capable of rejecting malformed or incorrect witnesses; a verifier that cannot say NO carries no proof value.
Provide enumeration, constructive mapping, symbolic theorem, induction, reduction, or equivalent mechanism that actually binds every x in D_z.
Do not replace FOR ALL x EXISTS y with EXISTS y FOR ALL x unless a single uniform witness is separately proved to work for every x.

quantifier_order_firewall.statement_a: FOR ALL x EXISTS y : V(z,x,y)=1
quantifier_order_firewall.statement_b: EXISTS y FOR ALL x : V(z,x,y)=1
quantifier_order_firewall.reason: In statement_a the witness may depend on x; statement_b demands one universal witness for all x and is strictly stronger in general.
quantifier_order_firewall.janus_rule: NEVER COMMUTE QUANTIFIERS WITHOUT A PROOF

epistemic_firewall: MANY WITNESSES != UNIVERSAL COVERAGE UNLESS THE DOMAIN IS EXHAUSTED OR A THEOREM COVERS THE REST
NO COUNTEREXAMPLE FOUND != PROOF OF ABSENCE
EXISTS y FORALL x != FORALL x EXISTS y

relationship_to_janus_methods.p_np_research: Separates witness verification from search and separates per-instance existential success from a universal theorem over an input family.
relationship_to_janus_methods.successor_grammar: A grammar covering one known witness establishes local reachability only; universal grammar claims require all-domain coverage or a theorem that entails it.
relationship_to_janus_methods.topa: TOPA may search for adversarial x values and counterexamples, but search exhaustion under a resource cap must return UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT rather than a false universal PASS.
relationship_to_janus_methods.representation_contract: The domain, verifier, witness encoding, and quantifier order are part of the representation contract because changing any of them changes the proposition being proved.

canonical_pipeline: DECLARE DOMAIN -> CHOOSE x -> FIND/RECEIVE y -> VERIFY LOCAL WITNESS -> OPEN UNIVERSAL COVERAGE OBLIGATION -> DISCHARGE ALL x OR DERIVE COVERING THEOREM -> VERIFY COVERAGE -> SEAL OR REMAIN OPEN

formal_laws.global: COVER(z) := FOR ALL x in D_z EXISTS y : V(z,x,y)=1
formal_laws.counterexample: EXISTS x* in D_z such that FOR ALL y V(z,x*,y)=0 => NOT COVER(z)
formal_laws.uniform_constructive_sufficient_conditio: FOR ALL x in D_z, V(z,x,F(z,x))=1 => COVER(z)
formal_laws.quantifier_lift_rule: MOVING FROM EXISTS TO FORALL-EXISTS CREATES A NEW OUTER ADVERSARIAL OBLIGATION

canonical_seal: A WITNESS PROVES A CASE. COVERAGE PROVES THE DOMAIN.
formula_seal: EXISTS y FOR x IS LOCAL; FOR ALL x EXISTS y IS COVERAGE; NEVER CONFUSE THE TWO.
